Even R1 Ring Exporter for Mac
Setup guide

Set up your R1 ring with ChatGPT

To see your ring’s sleep stages in Apple Health, go to Sync sleep to your iPhone. To ask ChatGPT about sleep and all six ring readings directly from your Mac, follow the setup below.

On your Mac, open ChatGPT for Mac, choose Codex and start a local chat in an empty folder. Keep the recommended model and default permissions. Copy the prompt below, paste it into Codex with ⌘V and press Return.

Read or select the prompt
Set up Even R1 Ring Exporter for Mac and connect it to my personal ChatGPT web account. Do the work on this Mac. Resume any working setup and preserve my archives. When I need to sign in, use my iPhone or approve a permission, give me one short instruction and continue after I finish.

1. Confirm Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later and Apple’s /usr/bin/python3 version 3.9 or later. If Python is missing, open Apple’s Command Line Tools installer. On the Mac, open https://apps.apple.com/us/app/even-realities/id6747017725 in the Mac App Store. If searching, select iPhone & iPad Apps if offered. Install or open Even Realities by Even Realities Ltd. (Designed for iPhone). Let me sign in with the same Even account as on my physical iPhone. Help me sync my ring on iPhone, review Health tracking and Cloud processing & backup, and confirm that a reading appears in Even on the Mac. If the store does not offer the app for this Mac, explain and stop.

2. Download the Mac disk image from https://daviddemri26.github.io/even-r1-ring-exporter-for-mac/downloads/Even-R1-Ring-Exporter-for-Mac-0.1.0-alpha.8-arm64.dmg. Verify its SHA-256 against the matching filename in https://daviddemri26.github.io/even-r1-ring-exporter-for-mac/downloads/SHA256SUMS before opening it. Stop on a mismatch. Install the .app in Applications and open that copy. Keep macOS security protections enabled. In Mac Collection choose Set Up This Mac. Use Show Collection Options to find Accessibility Settings and Show Collector. Let me allow Even R1 Ring Collector for Mac under Accessibility. If macOS asks to let the collector read other apps’ data, explain that it reads Even’s export and wait for my decision. With the Mac unlocked, run Test an Export, then Refresh. Verify this attempt says “Export verified”. Enable Schedule Collection and confirm the time shown under “Next scheduled check”.

3. Check ChatGPT Connection for an existing working tunnel. If one is needed, confirm my personal ChatGPT workspace supports custom MCP servers and my OpenAI Platform organization supports secure tunnels. At https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/tunnels create a dedicated tunnel linked to that workspace. Create a dedicated restricted project API key with Tunnels Read and Use. In ChatGPT Connection choose Connect Even R1 Ring to ChatGPT… and enter the tunnel ID. Let me enter the complete key privately at the assistant’s hidden Terminal prompt so it is stored in my Mac’s Keychain. Never ask for the key in chat or print it. Confirm the tunnel connects to OpenAI.

4. In my personal workspace at https://chatgpt.com/plugins, add a custom MCP server named Even R1 Ring Data for ChatGPT. Choose Tunnel, select my tunnel and use No authentication for the local server behind it. Keep the connector private. Choose Connect, then Try in chat. Ask “What are my latest ring readings?” without a file or any values in the question. Verify that the connector supplied the answer and compare one available result and its freshness with the local export or card. Keep raw archives on this Mac. Tell me whether the export, schedule and web query each worked. If anything is unavailable, identify the exact blocker.

Install

You need your Even R1 ring, your iPhone and an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later. Codex helps install two apps on your Mac.

  • Even Realities syncs your ring readings. In the Mac App Store, get the Designed for iPhone version. Sign in with the same Even account you use on your iPhone.
  • Even R1 Ring Exporter for Mac collects those readings automatically. Download Mac alpha 8 (.dmg), open the disk image and drag the app into Applications. Open it from there and choose Set Up This Mac. The release uses Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.

Connect

In the exporter, open ChatGPT Connection → Connect Even R1 Ring to ChatGPT…. Follow Codex through sign-in and permissions. It checks the first export, turns on automatic collection and tests a reply in your ChatGPT account.

Ask

In ChatGPT, choose Even R1 Ring Data for ChatGPT and ask “What are my latest ring readings?” Keep your Mac awake and online when you ask.

Your Mac checks for new readings automatically at 5:15 a.m., 8:15 a.m., 12:15 p.m., 6:15 p.m. and 11:15 p.m. local time. It retries every ten minutes for up to an hour while it waits for the Mac to be awake, unlocked and idle. To see the next check in your local time, open Mac Collection and select Refresh.

Need help? Give Codex the error message. For manual setup or troubleshooting, see the technical documentation on GitHub.

Sync sleep to your iPhone

The Mac alpha 8 download includes Pair iPhone. Install Sleep Sync Companion separately on an iPhone running iOS 17 or later. The iPhone app is currently available as a source build. iPhone installation and support

  1. With a verified sleep export on your Mac, connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi. In the exporter, choose Mac Collection → Pair iPhone.
  2. On the iPhone, tap Scan Mac Code and scan the code. Allow Camera and Local Network access, then allow the companion to write Sleep in Apple Health. The first sync imports the verified nights and naps already on the Mac.
  3. When the companion shows Up to date, open Sleep → Data Sources & Access in Apple Health and look for Sleep Sync Companion.

Future nights sync when you open the companion on the same network as your awake Mac. iOS also schedules background refresh. For a morning or Wi-Fi trigger, add the Sync Sleep action to a personal automation in Shortcuts.

If you use ChatGPT Health, connect Apple Health on your iPhone and give ChatGPT permission to read Sleep. Once it syncs, ask “Which wake dates have sleep from Sleep Sync Companion in my Apple Health data?” This route works independently of the Mac’s private ChatGPT connector.
